title: Cross-project Build -> Review -> Ship operating-manual quality
purpose: The single fixed metric ruler for the A/B/C experiment. Scores how good a build->review->ship operating manual is AS A REUSABLE, CROSS-PROJECT artifact that a fresh agent session can run unattended. Higher = better. Applied identically (blind to which copy) to copy1 (auto-tinker-loop), copy2 (claude-direct), copy3 (control).
scale: Each dimension scored 0.0-1.0. Anchor bands: 0.0 = absent/actively misleading; 0.25 = present but weak/prose-only; 0.5 = adequate; 0.75 = strong; 1.0 = exemplary + verifiable. Final score = sum(weight_i * dim_i), range 0.0-1.0.
scoring_rules: Score ONLY what is in the document text; do not credit intentions.
Penalize over-claims and stale/unverifiable assertions in the honesty + verification dimensions.
A gate that READS as hard but is enforced only by prose/session-memory scores LOW on gate_enforceability, however emphatic the wording.
Reward mechanisms that survive a fresh session with zero prior context (the doc's own stated purpose).

dimensions.desc: Is it project-agnostic? Project-specifics (host/CI/DB/site-ids/paths) isolated into a PROFILE or placeholders rather than hardcoded; a different stack could adopt it with bounded edits.
dimensions.band_1: A clear 'project profile' section parameterizes every project-specific value; the pipelines reference profile keys, not literals; explicit 'to adopt for a new project, fill X' guidance.
dimensions.band_0: Hardcoded to one project (one host, one DB, one site-id) with specifics woven through every step; unusable elsewhere without a rewrite.

dimensions.desc: Are the hard gates enforced by TOOLING/a runnable check a fresh session cannot skip by omission, or honor-system prose? Are known bypass paths (a build that skips tests, a deploy missing a required flag/token, an unnamed exclude gate) closed or at least machine-checked?
dimensions.band_1: Gates map to runnable commands/wrapper scripts that fail closed; bypass paths named and blocked; the tolerated-failure set is explicit and machine-checkable.
dimensions.band_0: Gates are bolded prose ('never bypass') resting entirely on the session remembering to comply; a single skipped read removes them all.

dimensions.desc: Can a fresh session with ZERO prior context execute every pipeline from the doc alone (its stated purpose)? Prerequisites, external refs, and ambiguous steps resolved in-doc.
dimensions.band_1: Every step is unambiguous and self-sufficient or explicitly points to the exact in-repo source; no reliance on unstated context.
dimensions.band_0: Key steps assume conversation memory or undefined external artifacts; a fresh session stalls or guesses.

dimensions.desc: Does it require claims/findings to be VERIFIED (regression test per finding, run the suite, check the real repo) and avoid stale/unverified assertions? Anti-hallucination posture.
dimensions.band_1: Findings require a failing regression test + proof-of-flip; factual claims are dated/verifiable; loop-until-dry; explicit 'do not invent' guardrails.
dimensions.band_0: Asserts fixed facts (counts, URLs, statuses) as static truth with no re-verification step; fabrication is easy.

dimensions.desc: Rollback completeness: code AND schema AND already-applied DATA migrations/backfills; reversibility; recovery from a bad ship without stranding state.
dimensions.band_1: Covers code rollback, expand-contract schema, and the DATA/backfill dimension explicitly; every forward step has a stated reverse.
dimensions.band_0: Only mentions redeploying the previous build; schema/data rollback absent or hand-waved.

dimensions.desc: Review layers cover the change surface; blind spots (e.g. auth/RLS, perf) stated honestly rather than over-claimed; cheap->expensive ordering.
dimensions.band_1: Layered review with each layer's blind spot named; no coverage over-claim; adversarial pass with a threat model.
dimensions.band_0: Claims coverage it doesn't have, or omits whole surfaces (security/perf) with no acknowledgement.

dimensions.desc: Uses cheap-context tooling (e.g. factstack/.pack for whole-repo context, blast-radius queries before edits) and robust agent orchestration (concurrency caps, rate-limit batching/retry, resume/caching, structured returns).
dimensions.band_1: Concrete cheap-context step wired in with when-to-use; fan-out template bakes in the concurrency cap + batched-retry the ops lessons demand; structured returns.
dimensions.band_0: No token-efficiency tooling; orchestration guidance that repeats the exact failure its own ops-lessons warn about.

dimensions.desc: Post-deploy verification that targets the NEW artifact (not the previous deploy), plus smoke/canary/console checks and alerting.
dimensions.band_1: Post-deploy smoke explicitly hits the new bundle; canary/console checks; failure alerting path.
dimensions.band_0: Smoke/observability targets the wrong (previous) deploy or is optional/absent.

dimensions.desc: Skimmable at the right altitude; indexed; a hurried session finds what it needs fast without drowning in detail.
dimensions.band_1: Clean section map + key-file index + tables; each section earns its place.
dimensions.band_0: Wall of prose, no navigation, buries load-bearing rules.

dimensions.desc: Living-doc discipline that is PRACTICAL (not self-blocking); unimplemented things marked TODO not asserted-as-done; no over-claims.
dimensions.band_1: Every not-yet-real capability is labeled TODO/provisional; doc-maintenance burden is realistic; claims match reality.
dimensions.band_0: Over-claims (asserts unbuilt guards exist); maintenance rules that are operationally impossible to satisfy.
